columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Nested-agent recovery should rebuild context only from a surviving full baseline
columns.title_zh: 嵌套 Agent 恢复只能从保留的完整基线重建上下文
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260829-012 with Skill 02 score 45/50. The mechanism restores nested-agent settings and reference context only from a surviving full world-state baseline while rejecting partial or superseded snapshots. This creates a bounded governance and recovery question: what persisted state is authoritative enough to reconstruct delegated-worker context without reintroducing stale or incomplete authority?
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260829-012，Skill 02 评分 45/50。该机制只允许从仍然有效的完整 World-state Baseline 恢复嵌套 Agent 的设置与 Reference Context，并拒绝 Partial 或已被替代的 Snapshot。它形成一个边界清晰的治理与恢复问题：什么样的持久状态才足以作为重建被委派 Worker 上下文的权威基线，而不会重新引入陈旧或不完整的授权状态？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how a full baseline is identified, how partial or superseded snapshots are rejected, which nested-agent settings/reference context are reconstructed, what lineage or freshness facts are preserved, and which tests prove stale state cannot overwrite the surviving baseline.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验完整 Baseline 如何识别、Partial 或 Superseded Snapshot 如何被拒绝、哪些 Nested-agent Settings / Reference Context 会被重建、哪些 Lineage 或 Freshness 事实会被保留，以及哪些测试证明陈旧状态不能覆盖仍然有效的基线。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Workspace trust must fail closed and shape the effective tool surface
columns.title_zh: Workspace Trust 必须 Fail Closed，并约束实际工具面
columns.source_zh: Gemini CLI 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260829-021 with Skill 02 score 44/50. Workspace trust now fails closed and restricted mode filters MCP servers, coupling admission state to the effective tool surface rather than treating trust as a UI label. This is a bounded architecture question about whether uncertain workspace trust must reduce executable capability until authority is positively established.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260829-021，Skill 02 评分 44/50。Workspace Trust 现在 Fail Closed，Restricted Mode 同时过滤 MCP Server，使准入状态直接约束实际工具面，而不是把 Trust 仅作为界面标签。它形成一个边界清晰的架构问题：当 Workspace Trust 尚未被正向建立时，系统是否必须同步收缩可执行能力？
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the workspace-trust state machine, which MCP/tool capabilities are filtered in restricted mode, how trust transitions change the effective capability surface, whether fail-open paths remain, and which tests cover uncertain or malformed trust state.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Workspace Trust 状态机、Restricted Mode 中具体过滤哪些 MCP / Tool 能力、Trust 状态迁移如何改变实际 Capability Surface、是否仍存在 Fail-open 路径，以及哪些测试覆盖不确定或异常 Trust State。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Bounded command execution must terminate the whole owned process tree
columns.title_zh: 有界命令执行必须终止其拥有的完整 Process Tree
columns.source_zh: Google ADK 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260829-018 with Skill 02 score 39/50. Command timeout now terminates the full local process tree so descendants cannot outlive the command lifecycle. Although the Industry selection also comes from a Google-owned repository, this is a separate primary repository and an orthogonal lifecycle-ownership problem; its merged implementation evidence and score clearly exceed the other Open-source Engineering alternatives, satisfying the portfolio exception for a second same-vendor object.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260829-018，Skill 02 评分 39/50。命令超时时现在终止完整本地 Process Tree，使后代进程不能越过命令生命周期继续存活。虽然行业架构入选对象同样来自 Google 旗下仓库，但这里是不同的独立主仓库与完全不同的生命周期所有权问题；其已合并实现证据与评分明显优于其他开源工程候选，因此满足“同一 Vendor 第二对象必须有不同研究问题与明确评分优势”的 Portfolio Exception。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify process-group/tree ownership, timeout and cancellation order, platform-specific termination semantics, descendant cleanup guarantees, race handling, and tests proving no child survives after the bounded command closes.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Process Group / Tree 的所有权、Timeout 与 Cancellation 顺序、不同平台的终止语义、后代进程清理保证、Race 处理，以及哪些测试证明有界命令关闭后不存在仍存活的 Child Process。
